_comment: Conservative starter motif set for the cap2 front panel. AUTHORED, not source-derived: a search of all 319 source appearances found no badge, star, heart, shield, letter or sport symbol usable in a 4x3 zone. The 1973 'motifs' the enclosure scan returned are shading artifacts (1729 in Sleeves alone); the only real extracted source motif is Beret (Leaf) at 15 cells, too large and semantically a beret's leaf. So these are drawn, under the grammar's constraints: within 4x3, in the base's own vocabulary steps, solid runs for readability.
vocabulary_note: digits are STEP indices into the cap2 base vocabulary [57, 81, 119, 165, 217, 254]. '.' leaves the field value (step 1). Motifs recolour with the garment because they are expressed as base steps.
grid: rows top-to-bottom of the 4x3 zone at x8-11, y9-11

bar.source: AUTHORED BY plurffle — the original Cap 2 / Cap 1 emblem, extracted

badge_round.status: EXCLUDED — indistinguishable from star, heart and ball at this size

star.note: a four-point twinkle; a five-point star is not resolvable in 3 rows

ball.note: a ball: light rim, darker seam across the middle

_distinctness_gate.rule: two motifs must differ by at least 4 of the zone's 12 cells, or they are the same mark
_distinctness_gate.measured: badge_round differs from star by 2, from heart by 2, and from ball by 2
_distinctness_gate.note: pixel distinctness is necessary, not sufficient — legibility at 4x worn is the real gate and is judged in-game
